FAQs

Do I need a partner?

No, you're welcome to come on your own or with friends. If you're coming solo, say hello when you arrive and we will help you get settled.
We usually rotate partners during class, so you will meet new people. You can also bring your partner and dance with them solely if you feel more comfortable.

What should I wear? Is there a dress code?

Wear comfortable clothes and smooth-soled shoes that let you move easily. Dress code is flexible — many dancers wear smart-casual evening wear for the classes and party but also feel free to dress up.

I have no dance experience. Can I still attend?

Yes! Start with the beginner class. We’ll take you through the basics step by step so you can get comfortable with the rhythm and movement.

Do I need to book in advance or can I pay on the door?

Tickets are available online (at a cheaper rate) or you can pay more on the door.

Can I just come for the social?

Yes. The party is open to everyone and you can buy a social-only ticket for £8 online or £10 on the door.

What happens at the social after class?

We keep the music going for social dancing with different genres of music ranging from Kizomba, Semba, Ghetto Zouk, Konpa and more. It’s a chance to practise what you’ve learnt, dance with different people or take a seat and enjoy the music.
